project_type: Next.js 16 App Router portfolio site (TypeScript, React 19, Tailwind v4) with Mongoose/MongoDB, Auth.js v5 (Google-only), Cloudinary image storage
build_system: Next.js build (next build). No bundler config beyond next.config.ts. Tailwind v4 via @tailwindcss/postcss. Package manager: npm.
test_framework: NONE. package.json has no jest/vitest. DECISION (locked by the step prompt): do NOT add any test runner. Pure functions are sanity-checked with a THROWAWAY `node` script that is deleted after use.
test_command: npm run lint   (eslint; there is no test runner). Both `npm run build` AND `npm run lint` are the mandatory gates.
verification_instructions: 1) For pure modules (lib/notePlacement.ts, lib/profanity.ts) write a tiny throwaway `node` script, run it, record results in .agents/tasks/musafir-cafe/verification.md, then DELETE the script. 2) Run `npm run build` and `npm run lint`; fix all errors; re-run until both pass. 3) Record build+lint outcomes in verification.md. Do NOT run `npm run dev` (long-running processes are blocked). NO git commits — leave files changed in the working tree.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in by build. Mongoose schema .index() declarations ARE the migration (built on first connect); there is no migration-file system. next/font/google self-hosts fonts at build.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell. Do NOT start `npm run dev`. NO git commits at any point. PROMISE_WALL_DB_URL may be unset locally — lib/promiseWallDb.ts reads env at import but THROWS only at call time so `next build` stays safe (routes import fine; only runtime requests 500). CSP in next.config.ts already allows img-src 'self' data: blob: https://res.cloudinary.com and font-src 'self' data:; it does NOT allow fonts.googleapis.com/gstatic.com — so fonts MUST load via next/font/google (self-hosted), never a <link>/@import.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md / CONTRIBUTING / .kiro steering files exist in this repo. Follow existing conventions: API routes export `export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'`, use NextResponse.json, try/catch + console.error + friendly JSON error, `@/` import alias. Every plain MUST be preceded by `// eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element` or the lint/build gate fails. Never use dangerouslySetInnerHTML for note text.
key_patterns: Separate DB: lib/promiseWallDb.ts uses mongoose.createConnection(uri).asPromise() cached on global.__promiseWallConn (distinct from global.mongoose used by lib/db.ts). Model binds to THAT connection via getPromiseNoteModel() → conn.models.PromiseNote || conn.model(...), NEVER mongoose.model(...) on the default connection. Identity: userKey(session) → string|undefined (lowercased email else id); guard `if(!uid) return 401` before any create/ratelimit/ownership compare. user_id is PRIVATE and NEVER serialized; `mine` is the only ownership signal. Rate limit: rateLimit(scope, identifier, limit, windowSeconds) keyed `${scope}:${identifier}`, fails OPEN, calls connectDB() itself (main DB); getClientIp(req). Cloudinary: default-exported v2 client (lib/cloudinary.ts); upload with { folder, transformation:[{width:1200,crop:'limit'}] }, store secure_url + public_id. sanitize(): the guestbook route's sanitize() is a PRIVATE module-local function and CANNOT be imported — COPY its identical logic (strip [\u0000-\u001f\u007f], collapse whitespace, trim) inline into the musafir route or a small lib helper. Modals: createPortal to document.body, focus-trap, Escape-to-close, reuse SignInPopup/ToastProvider/useToast from app/(site)/guestbook/ui.tsx. Sound: useSoundFx() → { enabled, toggle } from app/ui/sound/SoundProvider.tsx; paper-lift.mp3/paper-stick.mp3 do NOT exist yet — degrade gracefully (no file → no sound, no crash).
relevant_files: PRECEDENT app/api/guestbook/route.ts (private sanitize(), honeypot, model guard)
PRECEDENT app/(site)/guestbook/ui.tsx (SignInPopup, ToastProvider, useToast, modal/focus-trap/reduced-motion patterns)
PRECEDENT app/(site)/guestbook/Guestbook.tsx (next/image for stored images vs plain +eslint-disable for previews)
PRECEDENT app/layout.tsx (next/font/google Caveat with CSS variable)
PRECEDENT app/(site)/layout.tsx (shared site layout the new page lives under)
PRECEDENT next.config.ts (CSP img-src/font-src facts; no change needed)
directory_structure: app/(site)/ holds public pages under a shared layout — new page at app/(site)/musafir-cafe/ (page.tsx, MusafirWall.tsx, fonts.ts, types.ts, musafir-cafe.css, SETUP.md, components/{StickyNote,WallBackdrop,WallProps,NoteModal,Composer,DrawCanvas,RulesMailbox,LeaveNoteButton}.tsx). app/api/ holds route handlers — new routes under app/api/musafir-cafe/{notes/route.ts, notes/[id]/route.ts, notes/[id]/report/route.ts, upload/route.ts}. lib/ holds shared helpers — new lib/{promiseWallDb,notePlacement,profanity}.ts. model/ holds Mongoose models — new model/promiseNoteModel.ts. public/sounds/ has click.mp3 only (paper-lift/paper-stick absent).
note_geometry_constants: lib/notePlacement.ts is the single source of truth: NOTE_W=160, NOTE_H=160, PHOTO_NOTE_H=210 (isPhoto = Boolean(photo_url) is the ONLY height flag, identical at placement+render), V_WALL_WIDTH=420, H_WALL_HEIGHT=900 (fixed logical horizontal canvas height, device-independent), H_WALL_SEED_WIDTH=2400, V_WALL_SEED_HEIGHT=2000, GROWTH_STEP=1200 (growth monotonic, never shrinks). coveredFraction uses a 10x10 raster, cell-center sampling; callers pass the rotation-inflated RECENTRED box { pos_x: cx-w'/2, pos_y: cy-h'/2, w: w', h: h' } for A and every higher-z box; reject iff STRICTLY >40 of 100 cells covered (exactly 40 = >=60% visible PASSES). Stacking is the strict total order (z_index, created_at, _id), used identically in placeNote check (b) and DOM paint order (sort ascending). z_index assigned min(maxZ+1, Z_CAP=9000); CSS baseZ = min(10 + z_index, 9010).
